dataset.userAssertion: The source is user-created/simulated and is not the Harrison textbook.

mappingRules: One Part directory maps to exactly one canonical Course.
One Chapter directory maps to exactly one canonical Chapter.
An explicit source Lesson directory is a provenance anchor, not an in-app lesson boundary.
A source Lesson anchor may map to zero, one, or many concept clusters and micro-lessons after semantic segmentation.
A chapter without source Lesson directories still receives a complete semantic decomposition from its canonical chapter source and every supplemental artifact.
No product node may be promoted without source-fragment coverage receipts or an explicit reviewed exclusion disposition.
taxonomyContract.ordering: numeric Part, Chapter, source Lesson order; then normalized relative path. Generated IDs never depend on title translation.

decompositionContract.purpose: Quantify a short-session curriculum plan without pretending that source folders already define pedagogy.

planningTargets.interactionMixRequirement: Every session interleaves explanation, active recall, applied discrimination, feedback, and compact closure; long passive reading is disallowed.

estimateAlgorithm.conceptClustersMin: max(1, h4+h5+h6 headings, ceil(canonical chapter words / 650))
estimateAlgorithm.sessions: one planning session per micro-lesson; authoring may split but may not silently merge away source fragments
estimateAlgorithm.steps: 5 times minimum sessions through 9 times maximum sessions
estimateAlgorithm.warning: Ranges are workload estimates only, not authored curriculum or medical-semantic validation.

roleRegistry.part_manifest_markdown: Generated source structure index; never treated as medical lesson content.
roleRegistry.chapter_source_markdown: Canonical full chapter source for segmentation and coverage.
roleRegistry.lesson_source_markdown: Existing source slice anchored to an explicit Lesson directory; may duplicate chapter content.
roleRegistry.lesson_find_module: Existing Persian-oriented interactive/content module; audit as a derived artifact, not current authority.
roleRegistry.lesson_summary_module: Existing Persian-oriented summary module; audit as derived content.
roleRegistry.lesson_enrichment_module: Existing Persian-oriented enrichment module; audit claims and provenance.
roleRegistry.lesson_quiz_module: Existing Persian-oriented assessment module; preserve question/answer/explanation atoms for review.
roleRegistry.misplaced_lesson_media: Lesson-named media directory stored at chapter root; preserved as an anomaly.
roleRegistry.unclassified_lesson_module: Present source module whose filename violates the expected component grammar; still inventoried.

priorityMap.title: Disorders Cardiovascular System
priorityMap.rationale: User-mandated first domain; broad diagnostic, ECG, arrhythmia, heart-failure, ischemic, valvular, vascular, and hypertension coverage; strongest high-value starting corpus.

priorityMap.title: Cardinal Manifestations and Presentation of Disease
priorityMap.rationale: Cross-system symptom and presentation reasoning creates prerequisites used by every organ-system course.

priorityMap.title: Critical Care Medicine
priorityMap.rationale: Time-critical critical-care reasoning is high-value for residents and supports case-based practice.

priorityMap.title: Disorders Respiratory System
priorityMap.rationale: Respiratory disease closely couples to cardiovascular and critical-care pathways.

priorityMap.title: Disorders Kidney Urinary Tract
priorityMap.rationale: Renal physiology, electrolytes, acid-base, and cardiorenal links unlock many downstream cases.

priorityMap.title: Infectious Diseases
priorityMap.rationale: Large infectious-disease surface with broad clinical relevance and differential-diagnosis value.

priorityMap.title: Neurologic Disorders
priorityMap.rationale: Neurologic emergencies and localization are high-value but require a dedicated interaction grammar.

priorityMap.title: Endocrinology and Metabolism
priorityMap.rationale: Endocrine and metabolic foundations recur across cardiovascular, renal, and general medicine.

priorityMap.title: Disorders of the Gastrointestinal System
priorityMap.rationale: Large gastrointestinal corpus with common presentations and broad inpatient/outpatient utility.

priorityMap.title: Pharmacology
priorityMap.rationale: Pharmacology is cross-cutting; sequence it after foundational pathways so drug learning stays contextual.

priorityMap.title: Oncology and Hematology
priorityMap.rationale: Oncology and hematology are large high-complexity domains needing additional safety and update gates.

priorityMap.title: Immune-Mediated Inflammatory and Rheumatologic Disorders
priorityMap.rationale: High structural readiness with 117 explicit source lesson anchors; useful as a second pipeline-validation corpus despite following higher-priority acute domains.

priorityMap.title: Poisoning Drug Overdose Envenomation
priorityMap.rationale: Poisoning and overdose are urgent but compact and require current toxicology verification.

priorityMap.title: The Profession of Medicine
priorityMap.rationale: Professional practice is important context but not the first clinical mastery spine.

priorityMap.title: Consultative Medicine
priorityMap.rationale: Consultative medicine integrates best after system courses establish prerequisites.

priorityMap.title: Genes Environment Disease
priorityMap.rationale: Genetics becomes more useful after organ-system anchors and needs careful evidence/versioning.

priorityMap.title: Disorders Associated with Environmental Exposures
priorityMap.rationale: Environmental exposures form a focused specialty track after the acute core.

priorityMap.title: Aging
priorityMap.rationale: Aging should become a cross-course lens rather than an isolated early silo.

priorityMap.title: Global Medicine
priorityMap.rationale: Global medicine should become a cross-course lens after the canonical graph exists.

priorityMap.title: Emerging Topics Clinical Medicine
priorityMap.rationale: Emerging topics are volatile and therefore last in baseline extraction, then maintained continuously with freshness checks.

fragmentCoverageRequirement.promotionRule: Every source.file ID and every extracted heading, paragraph, list, table row, figure, media item, quiz item, and code/content block must have exactly one reviewed disposition before promotion.
fragmentCoverageRequirement.hashRule: Coverage receipts bind source file SHA-256, fragment locator, transformation version, locale pair, reviewer state, and destination IDs.
fragmentCoverageRequirement.noSilentDropRule: A missing source file ID, unmapped fragment, or changed source hash fails promotion.

dataBoundaryRisks.evidence: The user classifies the corpus as self-created/simulated, but observed files include textbook-like chapter numbering, named authors, bibliographic prose, and reproduced-with-permission notices.
dataBoundaryRisks.gate: Confirm text and media rights before Jules upload, repository publication, model processing, or user distribution; inventory does not establish ownership.

dataBoundaryRisks.evidence: Source prose and derived TypeScript contain clinical claims, dates, prevalence figures, treatments, and assessments without a normalized claim-level evidence/version ledger.
dataBoundaryRisks.gate: Generated lessons remain educational drafts until current authoritative primary sources and medical review validate every actionable claim and answer key.

dataBoundaryRisks.evidence: Canonical chapter Markdown, explicit Lesson slices, Persian TypeScript modules, and duplicated media overlap.
dataBoundaryRisks.gate: Deduplicate only through explicit source aliases; never delete a path or merge claims by hash alone.

dataBoundaryRisks.evidence: Canonical chapter sources are predominantly English while many existing interactive modules are Persian; this is not a verified aligned EN/FA pair system.
dataBoundaryRisks.gate: Author and validate aligned bilingual destination records with shared concept, claim, and answer IDs and locale-specific pedagogy.

dataBoundaryRisks.evidence: 30 files have absolute Windows paths at or above 260 characters; maximum observed length is 304.
dataBoundaryRisks.gate: Use long-path-aware enumeration, hashing, task packing, Git, and validation; never truncate source IDs or filenames.

dataBoundaryRisks.evidence: Many chapter-scoped assets reuse names such as image_001.png.
dataBoundaryRisks.gate: Preserve scoped source path and source file ID; never flatten media by basename.
